title: Structure-aware hybrid retrieval with selectable embedding profiles
description: Epic. Replace naive page text, fixed windows and lexical-only retrieval with structure-aware parsing (PyMuPDF4LLM through LlamaIndex), hybrid keyword and vector retrieval on the single Postgres, selectable embedding profiles (OpenAI default, Qwen3 on the single Ollama), optional local reranking and verifiable short-handle citations. Subtasks: ARA-070 to ARA-075.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ready paper, when a question is asked, then hybrid retrieval scoped to that paper supplies cited evidence with section and page provenance.
Given any configured embedding profile, when it is unavailable, then keyword retrieval still answers.
Subtasks ARA-070 to ARA-075 are completed or explicitly deferred with evidence.
verification:
Reopened as a P1 epic on 2026-10-09 after the user prioritized retrieval. Dataset evaluation is out of scope by user decision.
Completed on feat/rag-context (merge to main is the user's decision). Children ARA-070 to ARA-075 are completed: layout parsing and section-aware chunking, OpenAI and Qwen3 embedding profiles with blue/green indexes, hybrid retrieval with short-handle citations, catalog reranking (OpenAI Decisions by default), and the retrieval UI. Live on real papers: hybrid, reranked, cited answers; the reader highlights the cited sentence; Qwen3 4B reindexing served blue/green. Follow-up: ARA-080 (P2, memory-aware local model loading). Dataset evaluation was out of scope by user decision. Whole-branch review fixes on 2026-10-09 (journal: 'Whole-branch review and fixes'). Final: backend 802 passed with Ruff clean; frontend check 454 and build pass.
